images.title: Regroup the Roman symbols
images.purpose: Shows adding CCXXXII and CCCCXIII by counting each symbol and regrouping into bigger landmarks.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Before and after: a top row of counted symbol tiles in three groups, downward arrows, and a bottom row of regrouped tiles with the sum under it.
images.exact_structure: Top row, three groups with gaps: exactly 6 tiles C, exactly 4 tiles X, exactly 5 tiles I, all white tiles with dark outlines. Five of the C tiles are ringed in amber (#E69F00); all 4 X tiles are ringed in teal (#0072B2); all 5 I tiles are ringed in reddish purple (#CC79A7). Three dark arrows point down, one from each group. Bottom row: under the C group, tiles D and C; under the X group, tiles X and L; under the I group, tile V. Exactly 5 bottom tiles. Under the bottom row, larger: DCXLV. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Add Roman numerals by counting each symbol and regrouping five C's into D, four X's into XL and five I's into V.
images.description: Shows adding CCXXXII and CCCCXIII by counting each symbol and regrouping into bigger landmarks.
images.context: CCXXXII + CCCCXIII: C 6, X 4, I 5; sum DCXLV, which is 645 = 232 + 413.

image_decisions.why: Regrouping symbols is a process; a before and after of the counted tiles shows each regroup at once.
